# Redistributable Quant fixture

This directory contains synthetic data and a toy linear score definition created
for forecast-loop tests. It contains no market vendor data, credentials, account
identifiers, order data, or production model intellectual property.

The fixture is distributed under the repository's Apache-2.0 license. The
adapter verifies these files as inert, read-only artifacts; it does not execute
`strategy.py` or write to this directory.
